# Complete OpenComputers 1.7.10 integration

Pinned original release: OpenComputers 1.8.10, commit 667626d, MightyPirates/OpenComputers.
The universal JAR is merged unmodified after Industrial Technology's reobfuscation. Original IDs and namespaces are retained. Only the shared manifest and mcmod.info are combined. All upstream classes, Lua files, original textures, recipes, translations, manual, sounds and native VM binaries are retained byte for byte.

The matching source JAR and full upstream resource tree are included under opencomputers/ in our sources archive. Development JAR is compile/test-only and never shipped as production bytecode. upstream.json pins official download metadata and SHA256 hashes. Original license/credits are preserved in the runtime JAR and notices/.
